decisions.reason: Category elimination and combination are curation options; they do not change the candidate's independently recorded modernization actions.
Permitting category restructuring does not change the required or conditional answer layers for retained and newly added questions.
The restructuring options concern categories in the existing question set and do not alter the required AI preparation chapter.
Authority to recommend restructuring existing categories does not remove, combine, or otherwise change this planned new chapter.
The source establishes recommendation options for existing categories but does not change the first-time leader chapter.
Possible category restructuring does not change the 50,000-word maximum or the candidate's existing recognition that removed content may create capacity.
Existing-question category restructuring does not alter the separate leadership-focused preparation chapter.
The option to recommend eliminating or combining existing categories does not change this separately required new chapter.
The candidate's same-message approval gate already covers proposed category additions or removals before implementation; category combination does not require an additional state update.
Adding category-level recommendation options does not change the tracked-editing and rationale procedure for individual question deletions.
Category restructuring of the manuscript's existing question set does not affect the companion-resource package.
The curation options do not change the book's target readers, purpose, or quick-reference format.
